about_item: Good Quality, Polyester,Soft plush fabric with natural solid color.skin-friendly, no fading or abrasion.
Size & Package Includes: 18x18 inch, Set of 2 pillow covers, PILLOW COVERS ONLY, NO PILLOW CORE.NOTE: Due to hand-made and sewing, please allow a deviation of 0.5-1 inch.

Hidden Zipper & Application:We use a high-quality hidden zipper to enhance the elegant appearance and the color of the zipper matches the fabric.This is a perfect item for home living rooms, bedding, kitchen, car, patio,chair, sofa,bedrooms, offices autumn decor,It is a cute gift for your family and friends.
EASY TO PUT ON: Fold the full pillow core in half and stuff it into the pillowcase, then flatten the four corners and zip it up. Super easy.
WASHING TIPS: Machine wash in cold water separately, gently cycle only, do not bleach.Suggest hand washing or dry cleaning

summary.text: Customers love these Halloween pillow covers for their cute ghost pattern and soft textured design, with one noting it's a perfect mix of soft and spooky. The covers are versatile for decorating, particularly for the spooky season, and feature a sturdy zipper closure that's easy to remove the pillow form. They fit 20-inch throw pillows nicely, hold up well in the wash, and one customer mentions the color is thick enough that it doesn't show through.

insights.title: Appearance
insights.summary: Customers love the appearance of these pillow covers, describing them as extremely cute with a cute little ghost pattern that looks just as pictured.

examples.snippet: ...Probably too nice to be a Halloween pillow, but they are ghosts. So cute I bought more for everybody. Pink, white, and beige, all nice....
These Halloween pillow covers are such a cute and easy way to add some Halloween décor without having to buy completely new pillows....
Super cute! These were a great grab for Halloween - love that they're a pillow cover and not an actual pillow. Look just like the photo....
These are ADORABLE, I love the way they look, however it is worth noting that the zippers are sticky and the material they used for the ghosts does...

insights.title: Quality
insights.summary: Customers love these pillow covers, finding them to be of good quality, with one customer mentioning they received many compliments for them.

examples.snippet: ...They are GORGEOUS with the cute little ghost babies , great quality, and fit pillow easily. the ghosts are SOOO FLUFFY SOFT. do not hesitate....
Perfect for my patio! Seems like good quality so far. They have gotten some rain and have held up with no smell or shedding.
These are so cute! Love them. I made an excellent choice . Love the softness! The color! How well made they are.
So soft. Very bright color. Love these. Perfect for my couch. No shedding. Easy zipper to remove pillow form for easy storage. Great buy.

insights.title: Softness
insights.summary: Customers appreciate the pillow covers' softness, describing them as fluffy and textured, with one customer noting the perfect balance of softness and spooky feel.

examples.snippet: I absolutely love these pillow covers! The quality is excellent—soft, plush, and cozy, with a nice faux fur wool texture that feels so comfortable....
...The ghosts are like a furry fuzzy material so they are super soft. They did come vacuum sealed but I did not notice any kind of smell....
...They are so beautiful and so soft. The ghosts are super cute too! I purchased the white and they go great with my neutral fall/halloween decor....
...They’re actually fuzzy and raised on the case and it’s just adorable! Very soft - going to see if they have others for the other holidays !

insights.title: Seasonality
insights.summary: Customers find these pillow covers perfect for Halloween decoration, noting they add a festive touch and work well with ghost themes.

examples.snippet: These pillow cases as perfect for Halloween!! They are comfortable and have held up nicely. The white is the perfect white color....
These Halloween pillow covers are an absolute must! They’re so cute, festive, and add the perfect seasonal touch to my home décor....
So soft. Very bright color. Love these. Perfect for my couch. No shedding. Easy zipper to remove pillow form for easy storage. Great buy.
Machine washable and a great addition for Halloween!

insights.title: Zipper quality
insights.summary: Customers like the zipper quality of these pillow covers, finding it sturdy and easy to use, with one customer noting that it's wide enough to fit their previous square pillows.

examples.snippet: ...The size pits my pillows perfectly and the zipper is durable and didn’t catch much. They do shed a tiny bit, as expected....
...They fit perfectly over my standard throw pillows, and the zippers are hidden and smooth....
...The fabric on the back of the pillow is thin and the zipper is very small and doesn't feel like it's going to last....
...They are very soft as well. The zipper is discreet and not even noticeable when they are on. Definitely recommend!

insights.title: Fit
insights.summary: Customers are satisfied with how the pillow covers fit, particularly noting that they accommodate 20-inch throw pillows nicely.

examples.snippet: Love these, so soft and fit perfectly.
Beautiful color, the fabric is so soft, and a perfect fit! Excellent holiday decor! Good quality for the price!
These fit my pillows perfectly! They are exactly as pictured!
These are bootiful! I love the pillow covers. They fit perfect and are so soft

insights.title: Color
insights.summary: Customers like the pillow covers' color, describing them as clean white and vibrant, with one customer noting that the material is thick enough to prevent color from showing through.

examples.snippet: Beautiful color, the fabric is so soft, and a perfect fit! Excellent holiday decor! Good quality for the price!
These Halloween pillows are comfortable and just as vibrant as shown in the photo. They look great on the couch and add the perfect festive touch.
Product quality is good; colors are as pictured. Zipper catches puffed fabric but works with patience. These are the cutest pillow covers ever.
...Color is exactly as pictured, and seams are stitched tight....

insights.title: Durability
insights.summary: Customers find the pillow covers durable, noting they hold up well in the wash and don't rip. One customer mentions they will be using them for years to come.

examples.snippet: ...My kids love them! The zipper feels substantial and durable. We will be sad to put these away at the end of the season.
...Perfect for relaxing or just interior design. The fabric is durable, the pattern is wonderful, and the price point is great....
These are adorable! I’m not sure how durable they’ll be for extended use, but at least two seasons as long as my kids aren’t tossing them....
Price was great and they are cuter in person. Very soft and held up well in the wash. Fit my pillows as advertised....
